Creativity

What else could this become?

Creativity is a set of ways to explore possibilities: notice a pattern, try a different arrangement, follow a surprising connection, and see what survives the change.

Begin with a small pattern you can grow and count, then follow the larger questions of intention, authorship and composing a world someone else can explore.
